limitations: Original port list labels q as input, conflicting with an observable D flip-flop. Implemented q as output, interpreting that label as a typo.
Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed and remains pending.
implementation: One-bit positive-edge D flip-flop using a nonblocking assignment; no reset, initialization, or extra latency.
verification: Independent expected-state oracle checks initial unknown state, rising-edge capture, retention on falling edges and intervening data changes, repeated values, and four-state data.
